show.description: A kind-hearted girl’s trip to her brother’s wedding turns into a nightmare when she gets stuck on a chaotic flight with a cruel woman and her spoiled son. What begins as midair madness soon unravels shocking truths of power, betrayal, and mistaken identity. Get ready for a storm of love, lies, and revenge that explodes both in the sky—and on the ground.
